title: ValuesRAG: Enhancing Cultural Alignment Through Retrieval-Augmented Contextual Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to accurately reflect diverse cultural values by comparing its generated answers to actual human responses from six global regional survey datasets (e.g., World Values Survey, European Values Study, Afrobarometer). The methodology converts multiple-choice survey responses into binary agree/disagree formats and calculates the accuracy of the model's alignment with localized demographic and cultural values.
